assumptions: Positive forward flow; no elevation head, leak, parallel path or distributed line storage.
Synthetic mapping: P-TPT=P_U; P-MON-CKP=P_D; SYN-P-SEP=P_S; SYN-Q-PROD=Q. This mapping is supplied only for this model.
Bounds include calibration bias and noise, apply simultaneously and independently; clocks synchronized. GOOD endpoints are trustworthy within stated bounds.
Temperature is a passive first-order thermal channel with external cooling; it does not predict hydrate phase or generate hydraulic resistance.
SYN-OPEN-K is a stuck telemetry channel; percent opening is not calibrated hydraulic conductance.
No verified per-well real topology, fluid composition, free-water assay, inhibitor concentration, local minimum wall temperature, hydrate envelope or deposit sample supplied.
identifiability: Positive Q and simultaneous pressures across a segment identify its effective R under M1 with uncertainty bounds. M1 has no material-to-resistance constitutive law; material identity is not a hydraulic state variable.
limits: No gas slip, slugging, phase change, reservoir model, material chemistry, control dynamics, wave propagation or industrial validation. Do not recommend operational action from this benchmark.
material_assignments: Hydrate, scale and debris are admissible latent obstruction labels for any positive R_L trajectory, with identical hydraulic equations; they are not chemical simulations.
scope: This hypothetical producing-well outlet is a horizontal liquid-equivalent surrogate, not an installed Petrobras well.
topology: supply -> linear inflow resistance -> compliant tree node U -> segment L -> node D -> choke K -> separator S. No branches or pump in L/K; same local volumetric flow Q in L and K.
